text.tspan: Decadal average: Annual deaths from all natural disasters excluding
Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period. Disasters include events such as
earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are not included here because their
geographical and time coverage is poor, making consistent comparisons difficult.

tspan.tspan: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
